method: Local Python/OpenCV compositing, FFmpeg H.264; no network or paid service
resolution_note: 1280x720 export resampled from 1672x941 source; no claim of native 4K image detail
encoding: H.264 QP0 lossless coding after RGB to YUV420 conversion; preserves tiny effects without temporal quantization drift
note: The last-to-first transition is checked numerically. Player buffering is separate from media continuity. H.264 quantization can introduce small differences.

effects.steam: Layered rising wisps with advected density and widening turbulent path
effects.planet: Independent procedural cloud bands, fixed master lighting and protected rings
effects.colony: Two moving textured surface light pools, four phased windows and mast beacon
effects.laptop: Original display retained with scan sector and telemetry
effects.rings: Fine existing ring brightness/texture drift in a protected right-arc mask; fixed geometry
effects.distance: Five phased points of service-light activity at the colony; no added moving objects
